card.name: Just before the word dose
card.fires_on: The word or word piece right before "dose" or "dosage", such as DO before SE in capitalized headings, or an adjective like high, therapeutic or antipyretic before doses.

modes.label: Split capital DOSE
modes.description: The first piece DO of the capitalized word DOSE in headings such as USUAL ADULT DOSE.

modes.label: Qualifier before doses
modes.description: A word or word piece that describes the kind of dose, placed right before the word dose or doses.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write dose, doses or dosage as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "dose", when the text is about to say dose or dosage.
